semiconductor_relevance: High — Canon Marketing Japan is deeply involved in semiconductor process and inspection equipment, crucial for fabrication and quality assurance.
summary: Canon Marketing Japan provides specialized semiconductor process and inspection equipment, focusing on technologies such as ashing, etching, and chemical vapor deposition (CVD). The company offers advanced inspection solutions for wafers, panels, and modules, utilizing X-ray fluorescence (XRF), 3-D X-ray, and metrology systems for topology and flatness measurement.
capabilities: Ion and electron beam milling and etching tools
